## E — Market signal: parallel, angle and hill parking, disabled parking, no-parking places and emergency parking
Market research was not performed in this state worker pass and no CompetitiveIntel artifact was supplied, so the market pack for this topic is typed debt (OR-PARK-MARKET).
Open items: applicant volume, pass rates, seasonality, buyer persona, price expectations, verbatim voice-of-customer quotes, ad hooks and the named gap.
Manual-only observation, not market evidence: the long list of no-parking distances is a classic memorization pain point, which suggests a distance-matching drill angle to test later.

corpus_stability.reason: The Oregon Driver Manual is a two-year edition (the front cover names a two-year span and the back cover carries a single form revision code); fees and office details are sent to the DMV website rather than printed, and nothing in the selected pages suggests more than one rewrite per year.
